summary: Richtech Robotics Inc. filed an 8-K solely to disclose its receipt of a Nasdaq delisting notice for failure to timely file its Form 10-Q for the period ended March 31, 2026, and its submission of a plan to regain compliance by November 16, 2026. This is an ongoing listing-compliance disclosure, not a special situation such as a delisting or restructuring. The company continues to work on its financial statements and may appeal any adverse Nasdaq decision. No deal terms, prices, or strategic actions were announced. Watch for Nasdaq's acceptance or rejection of the plan and the timing of the delayed 10-Q filing.
